text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $84k with modest gains, while Ethereum is outpacing it with a 2% daily climb, suggesting some rotation toward altcoins despite BTC's dominance staying firm at 59.5%. The Fear & Greed index sits at 69 (Greed) with a slight weekly decline, indicating cautious optimism rather than euphoria, supported by solid 24-hour volume of $61B. Smaller caps like Solana are showing stronger momentum than the majors, signaling traders are willing to take on risk but haven't fully abandoned defensive positioning.
